product_metadata.title: C&F Home Shell 14'' x 20'' Aqua Coastal Nautical Sailing Tropical Beach Sea Life Handcrafted Cotton Quilted Placemat Set of 4 Shell Placemat Aqua Blue
features: Coastal living has never been so easy with these quilted placemats from C&F Home. Perfect for a beach cottage or everyday, these reversible placemats add the finishing touch to your tabletop. Mix and match for additional styling options. Stains and spills? No problem. These placemats are machine washable for easy care.
The Shell tabletop collection features a hand guided machine quilted scallop seashell shape, sure to brighten the room and create a captivating focal point.
description: Bring the tropical sunshine and seashells of the beach to your home, without all the sand! The Shell tabletop collection features a hand guided machine quilted scallop seashell shape, sure to brighten the room and create a captivating focal point. Reversible to same color/pattern, this collection is perfect for a colorful summerlike look. Crafted of cotton and machine washable for easy care.
